hook.text: Australian Aboriginal people say the world was sung into existence during the Dreamtime.

buildup.text: Dreamtime isn't the past. It's an eternal present where ancestor spirits shape the landscape.

discovery.text: Songlines map the continent. Each song describes landmarks. Sing the right song and you navigate.

twist.text: This is the oldest continuous culture: 65,000 years. Their myths are living maps and law codes.

climax.text: Dreamtime blurs waking and sleeping, past and present, myth and geography into one system.

punchline.text: The land remembers. The songs prove it.
